name: Animals Not Having Souls
overview: The Scriptures reveal a clear distinction between animals and humans regarding the possession of a soul. While Genesis describes animals as living creatures with life or a living soul (Genesis 1:20, 1:30), it is only man who is formed by God and given the breath of life, becoming a living soul in a unique and personal way (Genesis 2:7). Animals are created to move and live under God's command and provision, but humans alone bear the breath of God, signifying a special spiritual nature and relationship with their Creator (Genesis 1:28, 2:7).
